issues.description: Step counter shows 'STEP 4 OF 4' but this is step-6. The step indicator is wrong.
issues.root_cause: In apps/web/app/design/step-6/page.tsx, the step number is hardcoded as 4 instead of 6, or the totalSteps/currentStep props are incorrect.

issues.description: Multiple React hydration errors: 'Text content does not match server-rendered HTML' and 'Invalid or unexpected token'. This causes the entire root to switch to client rendering, indicating a server/client mismatch, likely from dynamic content (e.g., QR code, date/time, or random values) rendered without suppressing hydration warnings or wrapped in useEffect.
issues.root_cause: In apps/web/app/design/step-6/page.tsx or a child component, there is likely dynamic content (QR code URL, timestamp, or crypto token) being rendered differently on server vs client. The 'Invalid or unexpected token' suggests a syntax error in the source file or a template literal issue.

issues.description: Page is mounted as step-6 per console logs but the UI shows step 4 of 4, meaning the step progress indicator component is receiving wrong props.
issues.root_cause: The currentStep prop passed to the header/progress component in step-6/page.tsx is likely set to 4 instead of 6.

fixes.reason: The step counter is displaying the wrong step number. Step-6 should show STEP 6 OF 6.
If the step counter is driven by a prop, update to reflect correct step number 6.
Alternate prop name pattern — correct the step prop to 6 to fix both the display and hydration mismatch caused by wrong state.
